SOFTWARE SUPPORT AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT

This Software Support and Maintenance Agreement is between Tessera Robotics, Inc. ("Vendor") and Brightwater Logistics LLC ("Customer").

1. Support. Vendor will provide telephone and email support during business hours and will respond to critical errors within two hours.

2. Maintenance. Vendor will provide error corrections, updates and new releases of the licensed software.

3. Fees. Customer will pay an annual support fee of 20% of the license fee, in advance.

4. Term. This Agreement renews each year unless either party gives 60 days notice.
